service_health_problem_descriptions_json: ["You're receiving this notification because you're associated with one or more Azure subscriptions that use Azure Monitor Action Groups. Azure Monitor Action Groups has officially rolled out the new OTP feature to all regions in the Public cloud. New email addresses added to new or existing action groups must be verified using a one-time passcode (OTP) before they can receive notifications. This change is aimed at improving overall security. No immediate action is required for email addresses that are already configured in existing action groups. These addresses will continue to receive notifications. These addresses will be marked as \"Legacy Allowed\" after the rollout. However, adding a legacy-allowed email address to a new action group will require OTP verification. All new email addresses must complete a one-time verification within the same tenant before receiving notifications. An OTP email will be sent when the action group is saved, and the passcode will expire after 30 minutes. If needed, a new verification email can be requested from the Azure Portal Action Group blade. As part of this change, users will also be required to save and verify an email address before they are able to send test email notifications. Help and support If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A (https://aka.ms/azureqa). If you have a support plan and need technical help, create a support request. (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-portal/supportability/how-to-create-azure-support-request)"]
